# Ubuntu packages for the Linux CI job (Tauri 2 + udev/libusb). One per line.
# Read by .github/scripts/apt-install.sh; part of the apt cache key.
# `a | b`: install the first of a, b that the runner's Ubuntu release has. All six
# names below exist on both 24.04 (noble) and 26.04 (resolute) (checked against the
# archive indexes, Oct 2026); the ayatana line keeps the legacy name as a fallback.
libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
libgtk-3-dev
librsvg2-dev
libayatana-appindicator3-dev | libappindicator3-dev
libudev-dev
libusb-1.0-0-dev
